provenance: Compiler-author assistant claim-only readings saved after code freeze and before inspecting fresh compiled outputs. Not human gold.

cases.text: Text on the screen: "Views by Starlink".
cases.intended_meaning: The screen contains the exact text Views by Starlink.
cases.participants_and_scope: OCR wording is asserted, not the independent truth of a Starlink attribution.
cases.ambiguity: Screen visibility/text is explicit.

cases.text: Driving into haboob turns day into darkness.
cases.intended_meaning: Driving into a haboob causes daytime surroundings to become dark.
cases.participants_and_scope: Keep driving, entering the haboob and the resulting darkening linked; no driver identity supplied.
cases.quantity_and_time: Daytime changes to darkness; no clock time.
cases.ambiguity: May describe a generic effect or the current scene; do not invent a driver or literal nightfall.

cases.text: There is crowd cheering at the people entering the National Palace .
cases.intended_meaning: A crowd cheers at people entering the National Palace.
cases.participants_and_scope: The entering people are the target of cheering; entry is linked to those people.
cases.quantity_and_time: Cheering and entering overlap in the described scene.
cases.ambiguity: No cheering words or identities specified.

cases.text: Dogs were airlifted to safety in the storm's aftermath.
cases.intended_meaning: Dogs were transported by air to safety after the storm.
cases.participants_and_scope: Dogs are the transported participants; the storm aftermath supplies temporal context.
cases.ambiguity: No carrier or rescuer is stated.

cases.text: We can see a protester holding the Mexican flag suddenly get attacked by the police.
cases.intended_meaning: We see police suddenly attacking a protester who holds the Mexican flag.
cases.participants_and_scope: Police attack the flag-holding protester; the attack is visual content of see.
cases.quantity_and_time: Sudden attack; holding accompanies the described protester.
cases.ambiguity: No independent police identity or completed injury is stated.

cases.text: There are organized tents set up.
cases.intended_meaning: Organized tents are present in a set-up state.
cases.participants_and_scope: The organization and set-up apply to the same tents.
cases.ambiguity: No organizer or precise count is given.

cases.text: A banner reading "Together with the SSS, Russia" is visible.
cases.intended_meaning: A visible banner bears the exact text Together with the SSS, Russia.
cases.participants_and_scope: Banner visibility and its OCR text must both be retained.
cases.ambiguity: The slogan does not certify a world relationship between named parties.

cases.text: People are gathered in Mount Arafat.
cases.intended_meaning: People are gathered at Mount Arafat.
cases.participants_and_scope: Gathered people share the named location.
cases.ambiguity: No number or identities given.

cases.text: Timelapse of incoming massive dust storm.
cases.intended_meaning: A timelapse depicts a massive dust storm approaching.
cases.participants_and_scope: The incoming storm is timelapse content and retains massive/dust.
cases.ambiguity: No independent world claim beyond the depicted content is supplied.

cases.text: There are 2 black helicopters flying in the same direction in close proximity.
cases.intended_meaning: Two black helicopters fly in the same direction close to one another.
cases.participants_and_scope: Count, black color, shared direction and mutual proximity concern those same helicopters.
cases.ambiguity: No absolute direction or distance is specified.

cases.text: Kantipur and Kathmandu Post Office Building set on fire.
cases.intended_meaning: Kantipur and Kathmandu Post Office Building have been set on fire.
cases.participants_and_scope: Preserve both named targets and passive fire setting.
cases.quantity_and_time: The fragment leaves precise tense and progress unclear.
cases.ambiguity: Kantipur may be a named institution/building; do not invent arsonists or resolve that ambiguity silently.

cases.text: The car is parked at 1:53am on August 19th, 2025.
cases.intended_meaning: The car is parked at 1:53am on August 19th, 2025.
cases.participants_and_scope: The full clock and date modify the parked state.
cases.ambiguity: No driver or location is supplied.

cases.text: Fans are calling the Phillies fan Karen a Karen.
cases.intended_meaning: Fans call the Phillies fan named Karen a Karen.
cases.participants_and_scope: The same named fan is the target; a Karen is a label used by fans.
cases.ambiguity: Keep the personal name distinct from the label; do not assert that label as an independent trait.

cases.text: Man driving vehicle.
cases.intended_meaning: A man is driving a vehicle.
cases.participants_and_scope: Man is driver, vehicle is driven.
cases.ambiguity: No medium, name or destination is stated.

cases.text: Smoke erupts as rocket lands.
cases.intended_meaning: Smoke erupts while a rocket lands.
cases.participants_and_scope: Keep both events and their temporal as relationship.
cases.ambiguity: As need not imply that landing caused the smoke.

cases.text: Flights might be cancelled due to dust storm.
cases.intended_meaning: Flights might be cancelled because of a dust storm.
cases.participants_and_scope: Possibility applies to cancellation; the storm supplies the proposed cause.
cases.quantity_and_time: Modal possible cancellation, not an asserted actual cancellation.
cases.ambiguity: No airline, actor or date is stated.

cases.text: Loud explosive sound due to fireworks.
cases.intended_meaning: A loud explosive sound is caused by fireworks.
cases.participants_and_scope: Loud/explosive describe the sound; fireworks are its cause.
cases.ambiguity: A sound description does not by itself require visible fireworks.

cases.text: Dust storm may affect electric service in the area.
cases.intended_meaning: A dust storm may affect electric service in the area.
cases.participants_and_scope: Possible effect relates that storm to local electric service.
cases.ambiguity: The area and exact effect are unspecified.

cases.text: A man wearing a vest reading "Hajj and Umrah Services Association and Pilgrims" is visible.
cases.intended_meaning: A visible man wears a vest bearing the exact text Hajj and Umrah Services Association and Pilgrims.
cases.participants_and_scope: Visibility, man-vest relation and vest OCR text all matter.
cases.ambiguity: The text need not be spoken or independently true about an organization.

cases.text: Bright sun over a man praying.
cases.intended_meaning: A bright sun is above a praying man.
cases.participants_and_scope: Brightness modifies the sun, praying modifies the man, and over supplies a spatial link.
cases.ambiguity: No location or independent speech is stated.
